{
  "prompt": "Create ONE 16:9 design variant sheet for a prop of a silent hand-drawn animated film. Variant muse-03, Pop-star bubble (do not print this name). Pure black field #000000. Show the SAME bubble in exactly three states from left to right on one shared invisible baseline: small and whole; swollen with a small world inside; burst ring with flying fragments. No baseline drawn. Generous black separation between the three states and between detachable pieces. The bubble represents capability seen through glass: it swells out of a box, contains a tiny world with rays, then pops. Focus the sheet on the bubble prop, not a scene or box illustration.\nDesign: an unevenly bulging organic lobed skin with swooping lobes. On popping, it becomes a broken ring and pointed star shards radiating outward. Shards combine stubby blocky flat plates and sharp tapered star points. A coherent recognizable bubble design across all three states. Within the swollen state, a miniature world made of a tiny flat blocky silhouette, curling stalks with flag leaves, and discrete radial ray shapes around one radiant core behind the silhouette. Keep the core cream and the silhouette readable; no whiteout.
